messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Tiina, TRN-031 Sodankylä. New SFP in, port is up and optics ok, but still no traffic

messages.author: Tiina Tuominen
messages.text: Then that SFP is probably bad too, we've had bad ones lately. Put in another one

messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: I have one more in the car

messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Second SFP in. Same thing, port up but counters at zero

messages.author: Tiina Tuominen
messages.text: Weird. I'll open a ticket for the transmission team

messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Ok. Heading to the next site, will come back tomorrow
